name: io.github.tonyyang0504/hh_ru-mcp
description: hh.ru (jobs): me, search, get_posting. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_HH_RU_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: client_id of an application registered at https://dev.hh.ru/admin; used to obtain an application token (grant_type=client_credentials at https://api.hh.ru/token).

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_HH_RU_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: client_secret of the same hh.ru application.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_HH_RU_USER_AGENT
environmentVariables.description: Your application name and developer contact e-mail, e.g. 'MyApp/1.0 (me@example.com)'. hh.ru requires a User-Agent (or HH-User-Agent) naming the application and the developer's contact address ('Указание в заголовке названия приложения и контактной почты разработчика'); it is appended to the server's User-Agent.
